definitions.explanation: The process of checking products or goods for quality, defects, or accuracy before shipping, selling, or accepting delivery.

examples.japanese: {出荷前|しゅっかまえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{検品|けんぴん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To inspect the goods before shipping.

examples.japanese: {検品|けんぴん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{不良品|ふりょうひん}→不良品：19452_furyouhin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: A defective item was found during the inspection.

examples.japanese: ⟦{倉庫|そうこ}→倉庫：04044_souko⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{検品|けんぴん}⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}っている→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: We are conducting inspection work on the delivered packages at the warehouse.

notes:
USAGE:
Used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ to form a verb: {検品|けんぴん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧. Common in manufacturing, retail, logistics, and e-commerce contexts.

FORMS:
{検|けん} (to inspect, to examine) + {品|ぴん} (goods, products).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {検品|けんぴん}⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧ (inspection work)
- {検品|けんぴん}⟦{済|ず}み→〜済み：04013_zumi⟧ (inspection completed)
- {出荷前|しゅっかまえ}{検品|けんぴん} (pre-shipment inspection)
- {検品|けんぴん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|とお}る→通る：01243_tooru⟧ (to pass inspection)
- {検品|けんぴん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{弾|はじ}く→弾く：10886_hajiku⟧ (to reject during inspection)
